_comment: Student profile the Profile Agent fills (deck v3, slide 4: 'A 3-4 minute spoken story becomes a skills profile'). required = asked for until filled. sensitive = asked once, skippable, never pushed. lock = read back and confirmed before saving (deck slide 8: numbers and names locked). Edit freely; the agent and the UI read this file.

fields.label: Name
fields.hint: Full name as on school records

fields.label: Stream / course
fields.hint: Science, Commerce, Arts, ITI trade, degree name. Only ask from Class 11 upward

fields.label: Regular or distance
fields.hint: Regular, distance or open schooling. Only ask for college students; it decides some scholarships

fields.label: State
fields.hint: Infer only if the district makes it certain

fields.label: Last exam marks
fields.hint: Percentage or grade in the last exam

fields.label: Skills from daily life
fields.hint: Things they do at home, farm, shop or village: farming, repairs, stitching, accounts, teaching siblings, cooking, phone repair, animal care

fields.label: Limits
fields.hint: How far they can travel, money, time, family duties

fields.label: Family income per year
fields.hint: Approximate yearly family income in rupees. Needed for scholarships; the student may skip

fields.label: Documents they have
fields.hint: Aadhaar, income certificate, caste certificate, bank account, marksheet. Needed to list missing documents for scholarships

fields.label: Gender
fields.hint: Only if offered; some scholarships are for girls

fields.label: Category
fields.hint: General / SC / ST / OBC, only if the student is comfortable; some scholarships depend on it
